app_name: Cap Fund Academy — Buffer Social Automation
description: Cap Fund Academy publishes daily AI-generated social media content to LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok via Buffer. Posts cover rural capital access, USDA microlending programs (RMAP, RBDG, IRP), and government lending certifications. Content is AI-authored, compliance-reviewed, and queued automatically through Buffer's MCP server.

create_post.description: Queue a new social media post for LinkedIn, Instagram, or TikTok via Buffer. Accepts text content, optional image URL, channel ID, and optional scheduled time.

get_channels.description: Retrieve all connected Buffer channels including LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok profile IDs and metadata.

get_queue.description: Retrieve the current post queue for a given Buffer channel, showing scheduled posts and their send times.

update_post.description: Edit the text or scheduled time of an existing queued Buffer post before it publishes.

delete_post.description: Remove a queued post from the Buffer queue before it publishes.

test_prompts.prompt: Schedule a LinkedIn post for today about USDA RMAP microlending eligibility requirements.
What posts do I have queued for Instagram this week?
Post an Instagram caption about revolving loan fund design with hashtags.

test_responses.prompt: Schedule a LinkedIn post for today about USDA RMAP microlending eligibility requirements.
test_responses.expected_response_summary: The assistant calls get_channels to find the LinkedIn channel ID, then calls create_post with the composed text and addToQueue scheduling. It confirms the post was queued and shows the scheduled time.

test_responses.prompt: What posts do I have queued for Instagram this week?
test_responses.expected_response_summary: The assistant retrieves the Instagram channel ID and calls get_queue, then lists the upcoming posts with their scheduled publish times.

release_notes: Initial submission. Enables Cap Fund Academy to queue and manage daily AI-generated social media posts across LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok via Buffer's MCP server using OAuth 2.0 authentication.
